fields.name: chores
fields.label: Chores
fields.value:
Make the beds
Empty the dishwasher #Sam
Feed the cat #Mia
Water the plants @mon,thu
Take the bins out @tue
Homework check @weekdays #Alex
Wipe the kitchen counters #Sam
Tidy the toys away #Mia
Vacuum the living room @sat
fields.hint: One chore a line. Add the days it is due with @: @mon,thu (or @mon @thu), @weekdays, @weekends; without one it is due every day. Add who does it with #: Dishes #Sam (#Mary_Ann for a name with a space).

fields.name: resetHour
fields.label: New day starts at (hour, 0-23)
fields.hint: The ticks start again at this hour: 4 is 04:00, so a chore ticked at midnight counts for the day before.

fields.name: groupByPerson
fields.label: Group by person
fields.hint: A list for each person named with #, then the chores for anyone.

fields.name: showTomorrow
fields.label: Show tomorrow's chores when today's are done

options.label: Auto: high contrast where the panel shows no color

dailyChores.name: Daily chores
dailyChores.description: A checklist of chores that starts again every day: tick them off, see who does what, and how the last days went.
